notes.text: I-Blitz Split intsha ngokuphelele: yakhiwe kabusha kusukela phansi, ye-Android, i-iPhone, i-iPad, i-Mac newebhu.
Hlukanisa isindleko ngokulinganayo, ngamanani, ngephesenti, ngokwezabelo noma ngezinto. Skena irisidi bese ukhetha ukuthi ubani udleni.
Isebenza ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi futhi ngaphandle kwe-akhawunti. Ngena ngemvume nge-Google noma i-Apple ukuze ugcine amaqembu akho evumelaniswe kuwo wonke amadivayisi akho.
